Money.howThisWorksBody: Each cup first pays for its own milk, cup, card fee and staff time. What's left pays your monthly bills, in the order you choose — use the arrows to reorder. Once they're all paid, the rest is yours. Your month-end profit is the same either way; this just shows your progress.

Menu.staffTimeExplainer: Staff time per drink = today's staff cost ÷ drinks made, weighted by how long each drink takes.
